svg.title: llm-failover
svg.desc: Animated diagram: worker A streams tokens through a router that logs each one. Worker A is killed mid sentence, the router replays its token log and RNG state to worker B, and B finishes the same text byte for byte.

g.text: same bytes as a run with no crash
each row: pos, token, rng state
client sends a prompt and seed 42 to the router
worker A streams tokens. router logs each one, then the client sees it
worker A is killed mid sentence. its KV cache is gone
router replays its token log + RNG state to worker B
worker B continues the same story from token 7
same output as a run with no crash. SHA-256 match ✓
